tooling_cost_eur.note: No separate tooling cost assumed because existing DIN 5480 W30 x 1.5 x 18 spline capability, M20 x 1.5 thread tooling, h6 grinding setup, and inspection gauges are assumed available from comparable PM-SH-2214 production. Any dedicated customer gauge or special fixture would require engineering review before release.

lead_time.note: 8 weeks after order is accepted as feasible in this draft, subject to material availability, heat-treatment slot confirmation, and engineering sign-off of the original GS-4032 Rev. B drawing.

assumptions: Recommended plant is Germany, using the stated 78 EUR/h machine plus labor rate.
Material cost is EUR 10.10/pc for 42CrMo4 +QT / 1.7225 round bar with EN 10204 3.1 certificate, based on the reviewed BOM draft.
Routing times are taken from the reviewed routing draft; setup time is amortized over each quoted quantity scenario.
Direct manufacturing cost equals material plus rate-based routing cost. The 12% overhead is applied to that direct manufacturing cost.
Quoted unit price is calculated from total unit cost including overhead using a 22% target margin: price = unit cost / 0.78.
250 pcs and 500 pcs are treated as separate order quantity price breaks, not as a binding annual blanket agreement.
Spline is assumed to be machined before induction hardening with no post-hardening spline grinding or corrective rolling required.
M20 x 1.5 thread length is assumed to be the 27 mm right-end section shown in the feature card, pending drawing confirmation.
Bearing seats are ground after heat treatment to Ø25 h6, Ra 0.4, with runout 0.02 relative to datum A-B controlled at final inspection.
No scrap or yield adder beyond the provided routing and material allowance has been added.
Prices exclude VAT, freight, special packaging beyond protective oiling and standard packing, and any customer-specific PPAP or capability study not stated in the RFQ.
This is an internal quotation draft only; reviewing engineer approval and original PDF verification are required before release to Nordwind.
risks: Original GS-4032 Rev. B PDF must be checked to verify the GD&T feature control frame and exact controlled feature for the 0.02 runout requirement.
The M20 x 1.5 thread length and any undercut or relief detail must be confirmed on the drawing.
Localized induction hardening of the spline may distort the shaft; post-hardening runout check and possible straightening are included but remain a quality risk.
Case depth 1.5-2.5 mm verification may require destructive sample sectioning or supplier certificate agreement; inspection plan must be approved.
The 8-week lead time depends on bar stock availability, heat-treatment capacity, and grinder capacity.
If Nordwind requires customer-specific gauges, PPAP, first article report, or special packaging, additional cost and lead time may apply.
